left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Must agree to sign informed consent form, and to comply with protocol requirements, including study visits
-  Must have clear optic media in the study eye that is capable of producing high-quality fundus images

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Has active CNV due to causes other than AMD in the study eye

left.raw_text: -  Has retinal vascular disease  [OR] or retinal degeneration other than AMD in the study eye
-  Has had intraocular surgery, [OR]  cataract surgery  [OR] or LASIK surgery on the study eye within 90 days prior to the study

right.raw_text: -  Has had yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG) laser capsulotomy on the study eye within 30 days prior to the study

left.raw_text: -  Has active inflammation, [OR]  infection, [OR]  or other severe ocular disease in either eye
-  Has aphakia in the study eye

right.raw_text: -  Has uncontrolled glaucoma  [OR] or a history of previous glaucoma filter surgery in either eye

left.raw_text: -  Is a contact lens  [AND] wearer and is unable to discontinue their use in both eyes for the duration of the study

right.raw_text: -  Has a serious allergy  [OR] to, or experienced a prior significant adverse reaction to fluorescein angiography (FA) [OR]  or indocyanine green angiography (ICGA)

left.raw_text: -  Has participated in any other clinical trial  [OR] and/or has taken any investigational drug  [OR] or product within 90 days prior to the study

right.raw_text: Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria could apply
